messages.text:
"Act as a world-class AAA game development studio consisting of expert game designers, programmers, 3D artists, animators, AI engineers, level designers, and sound designers.

Your mission is to design and develop a massive, realistic, next-generation open-world action-adventure crime game inspired by the scale and freedom of Grand Theft Auto VI, but with completely original characters, locations, stories, missions, and assets.

1. GAME CONCEPT

Create a realistic open-world game featuring:

A massive modern city with surrounding countryside.
Beautiful beaches, highways, suburbs, downtown areas, and industrial zones.
A living world with pedestrians, traffic, businesses, and realistic activities.
A compelling crime story with multiple playable protagonists.
Freedom to explore and interact with the environment.
2. GRAPHICS AND REALISM

Build a visually impressive game featuring:

Photorealistic 3D environments.
Realistic lighting, reflections, and shadows.
Dynamic weather and realistic rain.
Day-and-night cycles.
Realistic character animations and facial expressions.
Detailed vehicles, buildings, and landscapes.
3. GAMEPLAY

Include:

Third-person character controls.
Driving cars, motorcycles, boats, and aircraft.
Character customization.
Weapons and combat systems.
Police pursuit and wanted-level systems.
Story missions and side missions.
Shops, restaurants, garages, and interactive businesses.
Property ownership and vehicle customization.
4. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE

Create intelligent NPCs that:

Have daily routines.
React naturally to players.
Interact with other pedestrians.
Respond dynamically to emergencies.
Remember certain player interactions.
Allow police and emergency services to react to changing situations.
5. OPEN-WORLD MAP

Design a large, seamless map containing:

A modern coastal city.
Residential neighborhoods.
Luxury districts.
Poor neighborhoods.
Countryside and forests.
Airports and harbors.
Beaches and islands.
Highways and rural roads.
6. STORY MODE

Create an engaging cinematic storyline with:

Two original main protagonists.
A believable criminal underworld.
Character relationships.
Unexpected plot twists.
Heists and dramatic missions.
Multiple endings based on player decisions.
7. TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENT

Build the game using Unreal Engine 5 with:

Blueprint and C++ systems.
Optimized 3D assets.
Advanced animation systems.
Physics and vehicle simulation.
Modular mission architecture.
Save/load functionality.
Optimized performance for PC and consoles.
8. DEVELOPMENT APPROACH

Do not attempt to build everything at once.

Start by:

Creating a playable prototype.
Building a small but detailed city district.
Implementing player movement and camera controls.
Adding vehicles and driving mechanics.
Creating NPC behavior.
Building the first playable mission.
Expanding the map and features gradually.
FINAL INSTRUCTION

Act as a professional AAA game studio. Provide complete development plans, project architecture, code, asset requirements, and implementation instructions.

Prioritize playable functionality, optimization, realism, and an immersive open-world experience.

The final result must be an original, high-quality open-world crime game rather than a copy of GTA 6

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
